description: Every root JSON key Podman decodes from the request body of POST /libpod/pods/create. The wire type is specgen.PodSpecGenerator, which embeds PodBasicConfig, PodNetworkConfig, PodCgroupConfig, PodResourceConfig, PodStorageConfig and PodSecurityConfig; all are anonymous, so encoding/json flattens their exported fields to the request root. InfraContainerSpec is json:"-" and contributes nothing. A field with no json tag uses its Go name. Read by app/internal/ownership/libpod_spec_generator_drift_test.go, which fails when a field here is not classified as one that names an existing resource, one that names a host path, or one that names nothing.
types: containers/podman pkg/specgen/podspecgen.go: PodSpecGenerator and the six Pod*Config structs it embeds
fetch: parse with go/ast; flatten anonymous struct fields that carry no json name; skip unexported fields and json:"-"
or: SOCKGUARD_TEST_PODMAN_UPSTREAM_REF=v6.2.0 go test ./app/internal/ownership/ -run SnapshotMatchesUpstreamPodman -count=1 (prints the sorted root_fields on a mismatch)
